package com.ntt.crosstest.audit

import android.app.Application
import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelStore
import com.ntt.crosstest.data.*
import com.ntt.crosstest.ui.viewmodels.AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel
import io.github.jan.supabase.SupabaseClient
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.Auth
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.MemoryCodeVerifierCache
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.MemorySessionManager
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.auth
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.user.UserSession
import io.github.jan.supabase.createSupabaseClient
import io.github.jan.supabase.postgrest.Postgrest
import io.ktor.client.engine.mock.MockEngine
import io.ktor.client.engine.mock.respond
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.StandardTestDispatcher
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.resetMain
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.setMain
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.RuntimeEnvironment
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config
import java.io.IOException

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(application = Application::class, sdk = [34])
class BusinessPolicyRecheckIndependentTest {
    private val dispatcher = StandardTestDispatcher()
    private val adminA = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
    private val adminB = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
    private val future = BusinessPolicy(id = 1, effectiveFrom = "2030-01-02", operatorNote = "Original policy")

    private class RecordingRepository(val client: SupabaseClient) : BusinessPolicyRepository(client) {
        var revision = "rev-1"
        var loseFirstScheduleReply = false
        var loseFirstCancelReply = false
        val schedules = mutableListOf<Pair<String?, AdminScheduleBusinessPolicyParams>>()
        val cancellations = mutableListOf<Triple<String?, String, String?>>()
        val cancelReasons = mutableListOf<String>()
        private var committed: AdminScheduleBusinessPolicyParams? = null
        private var committedCancellation: Triple<String, String, String?>? = null
        override suspend fun getBusinessPolicyConfig(futureLimit: Int) = BusinessPolicyConfigResponse(
            today = "2030-01-01", revision = revision, activePolicy = BusinessPolicy(),
            futurePolicies = listOf(BusinessPolicy(id = 1, effectiveFrom = "2030-01-02")),
        )
        override suspend fun scheduleBusinessPolicy(params: AdminScheduleBusinessPolicyParams): BusinessPolicyConfigResponse {
            schedules += client.auth.currentUserOrNull()?.id to params
            val receipt = committed
            if (receipt != null && receipt.requestId == params.requestId) {
                if (receipt != params.copy(expectedRevision = receipt.expectedRevision)) throw Exception("REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT")
                return getBusinessPolicyConfig(20)
            }
            if (params.expectedRevision != revision) throw Exception("BUSINESS_POLICY_CONFLICT")
            committed = params
            revision = "rev-2"
            if (loseFirstScheduleReply) {
                loseFirstScheduleReply = false
                throw IOException("Committed response lost")
            }
            return getBusinessPolicyConfig(20)
        }
        override suspend fun cancelBusinessPolicy(effectiveFrom: String, operatorNote: String, expectedRevision: String, requestId: String?): BusinessPolicyConfigResponse {
            cancellations += Triple(client.auth.currentUserOrNull()?.id, expectedRevision, requestId)
            cancelReasons += operatorNote
            val receipt = committedCancellation
            if (receipt != null && receipt.third == requestId) {
                if (receipt.first != effectiveFrom || receipt.second != operatorNote) throw Exception("REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT")
                return getBusinessPolicyConfig(20)
            }
            if (expectedRevision != revision) throw Exception("BUSINESS_POLICY_CONFLICT")
            committedCancellation = Triple(effectiveFrom, operatorNote, requestId)
            revision = "rev-cancelled"
            if (loseFirstCancelReply) {
                loseFirstCancelReply = false
                throw IOException("Committed cancellation response lost")
            }
            return getBusinessPolicyConfig(20)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun login(client: SupabaseClient, uid: String) {
        client.auth.awaitInitialization()
        client.auth.importSession(Json.decodeFromString<UserSession>(
            """{"access_token":"token-$uid","refresh_token":"ref-$uid","token_type":"bearer","expires_in":3600,"user":{"id":"$uid","aud":"authenticated"}}"""
        ), autoRefresh = false)
    }

    private suspend fun fixture(block: suspend (SupabaseClient, RecordingRepository, AuthRepository, Localizer, ViewModelStore) -> Unit) {
        Dispatchers.setMain(dispatcher)
        val app: Application = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication()
        SessionCacheManager.clear(app)
        val client = createSupabaseClient("https://fixture.invalid", "dummy-key") {
            install(Auth) {
                enableLifecycleCallbacks = false
                autoLoadFromStorage = false
                autoSaveToStorage = false
                sessionManager = MemorySessionManager()
                codeVerifierCache = MemoryCodeVerifierCache()
            }
            install(Postgrest)
            httpEngine = MockEngine { respond("{}") }
        }
        val store = ViewModelStore()
        try {
            login(client, adminA)
            block(client, RecordingRepository(client), AuthRepository(client, app), Localizer(app), store)
        } finally {
            store.clear()
            client.close()
            SessionCacheManager.clear(app)
            Dispatchers.resetMain()
        }
    }

    @Test fun queuedScheduleCannotExecuteUsingAnotherAdminsSession() = runBlocking {
        fixture { client, repo, auth, localizer, store ->
            val vm = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, auth, localizer)
            store.put("vm", vm)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            vm.updateDraftEffectiveDate("2030-01-02")
            vm.updateDraftOperatorNote("Confirmed by A")
            vm.schedulePolicy()
            login(client, adminB)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            assertEquals("The queued A intent must be aborted before calling the repository as B", 0, repo.schedules.size)
        }
    }

    @Test fun queuedCancellationCannotExecuteUsingAnotherAdminsSession() = runBlocking {
        fixture { client, repo, auth, localizer, store ->
            val vm = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, auth, localizer)
            store.put("vm", vm)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            vm.openCancelDialog(future)
            vm.updateCancelReason("Confirmed by A")
            vm.confirmCancelPolicy()
            login(client, adminB)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            assertEquals("The queued A cancellation must not use B credentials", 0, repo.cancellations.size)
        }
    }

    @Test fun explicitCancellationRetryAfterConflictMustUseFreshRevision() = runBlocking {
        fixture { _, repo, auth, localizer, store ->
            val vm = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, auth, localizer)
            store.put("vm", vm)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            vm.openCancelDialog(future)
            vm.updateCancelReason("Cancel this future policy")
            repo.revision = "rev-external"
            vm.confirmCancelPolicy()
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            assertEquals(1, repo.cancellations.size)
            assertEquals("rev-external", vm.uiState.value.currentRevision)
            assertNotNull(vm.uiState.value.cancelDialogTarget)
            vm.confirmCancelPolicy()
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            assertEquals("Explicit retry must acknowledge the refreshed revision", "rev-external", repo.cancellations.last().second)
            assertNull(vm.uiState.value.cancelDialogTarget)
        }
    }

    @Test fun recreationAndDraftEditCannotReplaceUnresolvedConfirmedIntent() = runBlocking {
        fixture { _, repo, auth, localizer, store ->
            val saved = SavedStateHandle()
            val vm = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, auth, localizer, saved)
            store.put("vm", vm)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            vm.updateDraftEffectiveDate("2030-01-02")
            vm.updateDraftOperatorNote("Original confirmed note")
            repo.loseFirstScheduleReply = true
            vm.schedulePolicy()
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            assertEquals(1, repo.schedules.size)
            val original = repo.schedules.single().second
            assertNotNull(vm.uiState.value.error)
            val restored = SavedStateHandle(saved.keys().associateWith { saved.get<Any?>(it) })
            store.clear()
            val recreated = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, auth, localizer, restored)
            store.put("recreated", recreated)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            recreated.updateDraftOperatorNote("A different draft after recreation")
            recreated.schedulePolicy()
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            assertFalse("Editing a restored draft must not replace the unresolved confirmed intent with a new request",
                repo.schedules.drop(1).any { it.second.requestId != original.requestId || it.second.operatorNote != original.operatorNote })
        }
    }

    @Test fun retryAfterRecreationMustReuseOriginalCommittedRequest() = runBlocking {
        fixture { _, repo, auth, localizer, store ->
            val saved = SavedStateHandle()
            val vm = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, auth, localizer, saved)
            store.put("vm", vm)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            vm.updateDraftEffectiveDate("2030-01-02")
            vm.updateDraftOperatorNote("Original confirmed note")
            repo.loseFirstScheduleReply = true
            vm.schedulePolicy()
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            val original = repo.schedules.single().second
            val restored = SavedStateHandle(saved.keys().associateWith { saved.get<Any?>(it) })
            store.clear()
            val recreated = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, auth, localizer, restored)
            store.put("recreated", recreated)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            recreated.schedulePolicy()
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            assertEquals("Explicit retry must reconcile the original operation", 2, repo.schedules.size)
            assertEquals("Process recreation must not create a second operation UUID", original.requestId, repo.schedules.last().second.requestId)
            assertEquals(original.operatorNote, repo.schedules.last().second.operatorNote)
        }
    }

    @Test fun editingReasonCannotChangeUnresolvedCancellationPayload() = runBlocking {
        fixture { _, repo, auth, localizer, store ->
            val vm = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, auth, localizer)
            store.put("vm", vm)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            vm.openCancelDialog(future)
            vm.updateCancelReason("Original cancellation reason")
            repo.loseFirstCancelReply = true
            vm.confirmCancelPolicy()
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            assertNotNull(vm.uiState.value.error)
            vm.updateCancelReason("Edited after lost reply")
            vm.confirmCancelPolicy()
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            assertFalse("The unresolved confirmed reason must remain immutable until reconciled",
                repo.cancelReasons.drop(1).any { it != "Original cancellation reason" })
        }
    }

    @Test fun dismissingAmbiguousCancellationCannotDiscardItsRequestId() = runBlocking {
        fixture { _, repo, auth, localizer, store ->
            val vm = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, auth, localizer)
            store.put("vm", vm)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            vm.openCancelDialog(future)
            vm.updateCancelReason("Original cancellation reason")
            repo.loseFirstCancelReply = true
            vm.confirmCancelPolicy()
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            val originalRequestId = repo.cancellations.single().third
            vm.dismissCancelDialog()
            vm.openCancelDialog(future)
            assertEquals("An unresolved cancellation must retain its original UUID", originalRequestId, vm.uiState.value.cancelRequestId)
            assertEquals("Original cancellation reason", vm.uiState.value.cancelReason)
            vm.confirmCancelPolicy()
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            assertEquals(2, repo.cancellations.size)
            assertEquals("Closing a dialog cannot discard a possibly committed request", originalRequestId, repo.cancellations.last().third)
            assertEquals("Original cancellation reason", repo.cancelReasons.last())
        }
    }
}

534:     fun schedulePolicy() {
535:         reconcileActiveUser()
536:         // Synchronous action gate before coroutine launch
537:         if (!isActionInProgress.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
538:             return
539:         }
540: 
541:         val s = _uiState.value
542:         val effectiveDate = s.draftEffectiveDate.trim()
543:         val note = s.draftOperatorNote.trim()
544:         val today = s.todayDate
545: 
546:         val effectiveLocalDate = try {
547:             java.time.LocalDate.parse(effectiveDate)
548:         } catch (_: Exception) {
549:             isActionInProgress.set(false)
550:             _uiState.update { it.copy(error = localizer.get(R.string.admin_policy_date_required)) }
551:             return
552:         }
553: 
554:         val todayLocalDate = try {
555:             if (today.isNotBlank()) java.time.LocalDate.parse(today) else com.ntt.crosstest.util.VnTime.today()
556:         } catch (_: Exception) {
557:             com.ntt.crosstest.util.VnTime.today()
558:         }
559: 
560:         if (!effectiveLocalDate.isAfter(todayLocalDate)) {
561:             isActionInProgress.set(false)
562:             _uiState.update { it.copy(error = localizer.get(R.string.admin_policy_date_required)) }
563:             return
564:         }
565: 
566:         if (note.isBlank() || note.length > 1000) {
567:             isActionInProgress.set(false)
568:             _uiState.update { it.copy(error = localizer.get(R.string.admin_policy_note_required)) }
569:             return
570:         }
571: 
572:         val welcome = s.draftWelcomeCredits.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
573:         val t1 = s.draftPenaltyTier1.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
574:         val t2 = s.draftPenaltyTier2.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
575:         val t3 = s.draftPenaltyTier3.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
576:         val t4 = s.draftPenaltyTier4.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
577:         val push = s.draftPushFee.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
578:         val s2 = s.draftSlotFee2.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
579:         val s3 = s.draftSlotFee3.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
580:         val s4 = s.draftSlotFee4Plus.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
581:         val days = s.draftSlotRenewalDays.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
582:         val prov = s.draftReportProvisional.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
583:         val rTester = s.draftReportReviewTesterBonus.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
584:         val rOwner = s.draftReportReviewOwnerBonus.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
585:         val updReward = s.draftAppUpdateRewardPerClaim.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
586:         val updMax = s.draftAppUpdateMaxClaims.toIntOrNull() ?: -1
587: 
588:         val isValid = welcome in 0..10000 &&
589:                 t1 in 0..100 && t2 in 0..100 && t3 in 0..100 && t4 in 0..100 &&
590:                 t1 <= t2 && t2 <= t3 && t3 <= t4 &&
591:                 push in 1..10000 &&
592:                 s2 in 1..10000 && s3 in 1..10000 && s4 in 1..10000 &&
593:                 days in 1..365 &&
594:                 prov in 0..1000 && rTester in 0..1000 && rOwner in 0..1000 &&
595:                 updReward in 1..1000 && updMax in 1..1000
596: 
597:         if (!isValid) {
598:             isActionInProgress.set(false)
599:             _uiState.update { it.copy(error = localizer.get(R.string.admin_policy_validation_error)) }
600:             return
601:         }
602: 
603:         val submittedPayloadHash = computeCurrentDraftPayloadHash()
604:         val requestId = s.draftMutationRequestId
605:         lastSchedulePayloadHash = submittedPayloadHash
606: 
607:         val seq = mutationSeq.incrementAndGet()
608:         val reqUid = activeUserId
609:         val reqGen = activeGeneration

import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.RuntimeEnvironment
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(application = Application::class, sdk = [34])
class AdminBusinessPolicyViewModelTest {

    private val testDispatcher = StandardTestDispatcher()
    private lateinit var dummySupabase: SupabaseClient
    private lateinit var localizer: Localizer
    private lateinit var authRepository: AuthRepository

    @Before
    fun setUp() {
        Dispatchers.setMain(testDispatcher)
        dummySupabase = createSupabaseClient("https://fixture.invalid", "dummy") {
            install(Auth) {
                enableLifecycleCallbacks = false
                sessionManager = MemorySessionManager()
                codeVerifierCache = MemoryCodeVerifierCache()
                autoLoadFromStorage = false
                autoSaveToStorage = false
            }
            install(Postgrest)
            httpEngine = MockEngine { respond("{}") }
        }
        val context = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication()
        localizer = Localizer(context)
        authRepository = AuthRepository(dummySupabase, context)
    }

    @After
    fun tearDown() {
        kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking { dummySupabase.close() }
        Dispatchers.resetMain()
    }

    private class FakeBusinessPolicyRepository : BusinessPolicyRepository(
        createSupabaseClient("https://fixture.invalid", "dummy") {
            install(Auth) {
                enableLifecycleCallbacks = false
                sessionManager = MemorySessionManager()
                codeVerifierCache = MemoryCodeVerifierCache()
                autoLoadFromStorage = false
                autoSaveToStorage = false
            }
            install(Postgrest)
            httpEngine = MockEngine { respond("{}") }
        }
    ) {
        var currentRevision = "rev-initial-1"
        var scheduleCallCount = 0
        var cancelCallCount = 0
        var shouldThrowConflict = false
        var lastScheduleParams: AdminScheduleBusinessPolicyParams? = null

        var activePolicy = BusinessPolicy(
            id = 1,
            welcomeCredits = 100,
            pushFee = 100,
            operatorNote = "Baseline",
            isBaseline = true,
        )
        var futurePolicies = mutableListOf<BusinessPolicy>()
        var historyItems = mutableListOf<BusinessPolicyHistoryItem>()

        override suspend fun getBusinessPolicyConfig(futureLimit: Int): BusinessPolicyConfigResponse {
            return BusinessPolicyConfigResponse(
                today = "2026-11-01",
                timezone = "Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh",
                revision = currentRevision,
                activePolicy = activePolicy,
                futurePolicies = futurePolicies.toList(),
                futureHasMore = false,
                futureNextCursor = null,
            )
        }

        override suspend fun scheduleBusinessPolicy(params: AdminScheduleBusinessPolicyParams): BusinessPolicyConfigResponse {
            scheduleCallCount++
            lastScheduleParams = params
            if (shouldThrowConflict) {
                currentRevision = "rev-conflict-2"
                throw Exception("BUSINESS_POLICY_CONFLICT: Revision mismatch")
            }
            currentRevision = "rev-scheduled-success"
            val scheduled = BusinessPolicy(
                id = 99,
                effectiveFrom = params.effectiveFrom,
                welcomeCredits = params.welcomeCredits,
                pushFee = params.pushFee,
                operatorNote = params.operatorNote,
            )
            futurePolicies.add(scheduled)
            return getBusinessPolicyConfig()
        }

        override suspend fun cancelBusinessPolicy(
            effectiveFrom: String,
            operatorNote: String,
            expectedRevision: String,
            requestId: String?,
        ): BusinessPolicyConfigResponse {
            cancelCallCount++
            if (shouldThrowConflict) {
                currentRevision = "rev-cancel-conflict"
                throw Exception("BUSINESS_POLICY_CONFLICT: Revision mismatch")
            }
            futurePolicies.removeAll { it.effectiveFrom == effectiveFrom }
            currentRevision = "rev-cancel-success"
            return getBusinessPolicyConfig()
        }

        override suspend fun getBusinessPolicyHistory(
            limit: Int,
            cursorId: Long?,
        ): BusinessPolicyHistoryEnvelope {
            val filtered = if (cursorId == null) historyItems else historyItems.filter { it.id < cursorId }
            val page = filtered.take(limit)
            val hasMore = filtered.size > limit
            val nextCursor = if (hasMore) page.lastOrNull()?.id else null
            return BusinessPolicyHistoryEnvelope(
                items = page,
                nextCursor = nextCursor,
                hasMore = hasMore,
            )
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun init_loadsActiveConfigAndDefaults() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        val viewModel = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        val state = viewModel.uiState.value
        assertEquals("rev-initial-1", state.currentRevision)
        assertEquals("2026-11-01", state.todayDate)
        assertEquals(100, state.activePolicy?.welcomeCredits)
        assertEquals("100", state.draftWelcomeCredits)
        assertEquals("100", state.draftPushFee)
    }

    @Test
    fun selectTab_updatesActiveTab() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        val viewModel = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        viewModel.selectTab(BusinessPolicyAdminTab.EDITOR)
        assertEquals(BusinessPolicyAdminTab.EDITOR, viewModel.uiState.value.activeTab)

        viewModel.selectTab(BusinessPolicyAdminTab.SCHEDULED)
        assertEquals(BusinessPolicyAdminTab.SCHEDULED, viewModel.uiState.value.activeTab)
    }

    @Test
    fun derivedUpdateBudget_calculatesDynamically() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        val viewModel = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        viewModel.updateDraftAppUpdateRewardPerClaim("8")
        viewModel.updateDraftAppUpdateMaxClaims("25")
        assertEquals(200, viewModel.uiState.value.derivedUpdateBudget)

        viewModel.updateDraftAppUpdateRewardPerClaim("10")
        viewModel.updateDraftAppUpdateMaxClaims("30")
        assertEquals(300, viewModel.uiState.value.derivedUpdateBudget)
    }

    @Test
    fun schedulePolicy_validatesUnorderedPenaltyTiers() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        val viewModel = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        viewModel.updateDraftEffectiveDate("2026-12-01")
        viewModel.updateDraftOperatorNote("Test schedule")
        // Invalid ordering: tier 1 > tier 2
        viewModel.updateDraftPenaltyTier1("15")
        viewModel.updateDraftPenaltyTier2("5")
        viewModel.updateDraftPenaltyTier3("20")
        viewModel.updateDraftPenaltyTier4("25")

        viewModel.schedulePolicy()
        advanceUntilIdle()

        assertNotNull(viewModel.uiState.value.error)
        assertEquals(0, repo.scheduleCallCount)
    }

    @Test
    fun schedulePolicy_validatesPastOrTodayDate() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        val viewModel = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        viewModel.updateDraftEffectiveDate("2026-11-01") // Today
        viewModel.updateDraftOperatorNote("Note")

        viewModel.schedulePolicy()
        advanceUntilIdle()

        assertNotNull(viewModel.uiState.value.error)
        assertEquals(0, repo.scheduleCallCount)
    }

    @Test
    fun schedulePolicy_conflictRetainsDraftWhileReloadingLatestRevision() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        val viewModel = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        viewModel.updateDraftEffectiveDate("2026-12-01")
        viewModel.updateDraftWelcomeCredits("250")
        viewModel.updateDraftPushFee("180")
        viewModel.updateDraftOperatorNote("Draft changes")

        repo.shouldThrowConflict = true
        viewModel.schedulePolicy()
        advanceUntilIdle()

        val state = viewModel.uiState.value
        // Error message set
        assertNotNull(state.error)
        // User's draft values must NOT be lost
        assertEquals("2026-12-01", state.draftEffectiveDate)
        assertEquals("250", state.draftWelcomeCredits)
        assertEquals("180", state.draftPushFee)
        assertEquals("Draft changes", state.draftOperatorNote)
        // Revision was reloaded to the new conflict revision
        assertEquals("rev-conflict-2", state.currentRevision)

        // Retry with latest revision succeeds
        repo.shouldThrowConflict = false
        viewModel.schedulePolicy()
        advanceUntilIdle()

        val successState = viewModel.uiState.value
        assertNull(successState.error)
        assertNotNull(successState.successMessage)
        assertEquals(BusinessPolicyAdminTab.SCHEDULED, successState.activeTab)
        assertEquals("rev-scheduled-success", successState.currentRevision)
    }

    @Test
    fun cancelPolicy_flowExecutesAndClearsDialog() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        val scheduled = BusinessPolicy(id = 10, effectiveFrom = "2026-12-15", operatorNote = "To cancel")
        repo.futurePolicies.add(scheduled)

        val viewModel = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        assertEquals(1, viewModel.uiState.value.futurePolicies.size)

        viewModel.openCancelDialog(scheduled)
        assertNotNull(viewModel.uiState.value.cancelDialogTarget)

        viewModel.updateCancelReason("Admin cancellation reason")
        viewModel.confirmCancelPolicy()
        advanceUntilIdle()

        val state = viewModel.uiState.value
        assertNull(state.cancelDialogTarget)
        assertNotNull(state.successMessage)
        assertEquals(0, state.futurePolicies.size)
        assertEquals(1, repo.cancelCallCount)
    }

    @Test
    fun historyPagination_loadsItemsAndAppendsOnLoadMore() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        for (i in 1..25) {
            repo.historyItems.add(
                BusinessPolicyHistoryItem(
                    id = i.toLong(),
                    policyId = 1,
                    operation = "UPDATE",
                    operatorNote = "Change #$i",
                    changedAt = "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z"
                )
            )
        }
        repo.historyItems.sortByDescending { it.id }

        val viewModel = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        viewModel.selectTab(BusinessPolicyAdminTab.HISTORY)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        val state1 = viewModel.uiState.value
        assertEquals(20, state1.historyItems.size)
        assertTrue(state1.historyHasMore)

        viewModel.loadMoreHistory()
        advanceUntilIdle()

        val state2 = viewModel.uiState.value
        assertEquals(25, state2.historyItems.size)
        assertFalse(state2.historyHasMore)
    }

    @Test
    fun cancelPolicy_conflictRetainsDialogAndUuidForExplicitRetry() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        val scheduled = BusinessPolicy(id = 15, effectiveFrom = "2026-12-20", operatorNote = "Will conflict")
        repo.futurePolicies.add(scheduled)

        val viewModel = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        viewModel.openCancelDialog(scheduled)
        val initialReqId = viewModel.uiState.value.cancelRequestId
        assertNotNull(initialReqId)

        viewModel.updateCancelReason("Reason for cancel")
        repo.shouldThrowConflict = true
        viewModel.confirmCancelPolicy()
        advanceUntilIdle()

        val conflictState = viewModel.uiState.value
        // Error shown
        assertNotNull(conflictState.error)
        // Dialog target and reason are RETAINED, NOT dropped!
        assertNotNull(conflictState.cancelDialogTarget)
        assertEquals("Reason for cancel", conflictState.cancelReason)
        assertEquals(initialReqId, conflictState.cancelRequestId)
        // Revision updated to new conflict revision
        assertEquals("rev-cancel-conflict", conflictState.currentRevision)

        // Retry succeeds with the SAME intent and dialog is closed
        repo.shouldThrowConflict = false
        viewModel.confirmCancelPolicy()
        advanceUntilIdle()

        val successState = viewModel.uiState.value
        assertNull(successState.cancelDialogTarget)
        assertNotNull(successState.successMessage)
    }

    @Test
    fun schedulePolicy_synchronousActionGate_blocksDoubleInvoke() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        val viewModel = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        viewModel.updateDraftEffectiveDate("2026-12-05")
        viewModel.updateDraftOperatorNote("Single launch check")

        // First invoke initiates schedule
        viewModel.schedulePolicy()
        // Second invoke immediately while action is in progress is blocked by synchronous gate
        viewModel.schedulePolicy()
        advanceUntilIdle()

        assertEquals(1, repo.scheduleCallCount)
    }

    @Test
    fun schedulePolicy_editingInputs_rotatesDraftRequestId() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        val viewModel = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        viewModel.updateDraftEffectiveDate("2026-12-05")
        viewModel.updateDraftOperatorNote("Initial note")
        val reqId1 = viewModel.uiState.value.draftMutationRequestId

        // 1. First submit with simulated conflict
        repo.shouldThrowConflict = true
        viewModel.schedulePolicy()
        advanceUntilIdle()

        assertEquals(reqId1, repo.lastScheduleParams?.requestId)
        assertEquals("Initial note", repo.lastScheduleParams?.operatorNote)

        // 2. Unresolved retry without editing inputs retains same UUID
        viewModel.schedulePolicy()
        advanceUntilIdle()
        assertEquals(reqId1, repo.lastScheduleParams?.requestId)

        // 3. User edits note -> intent changed -> fresh UUID rotated
        viewModel.updateDraftOperatorNote("Updated note with new requirements")
        val reqId2 = viewModel.uiState.value.draftMutationRequestId
        assertNotEquals(reqId1, reqId2)
    }

    @Test
    fun savedStateHandle_restoresPrimitiveDraftAcrossRecreation() = runTest {
        val repo = FakeBusinessPolicyRepository()
        val savedState = androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle()

        val vm1 = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer, savedState)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        vm1.updateDraftEffectiveDate("2026-12-10")
        vm1.updateDraftWelcomeCredits("300")
        vm1.updateDraftPushFee("250")
        vm1.updateDraftOperatorNote("Persisted note across config changes")

        // Simulate ViewModel recreation with same SavedStateHandle
        val vm2 = AdminBusinessPolicyViewModel(repo, authRepository, localizer, savedState)
        advanceUntilIdle()

        val state = vm2.uiState.value
        assertEquals("2026-12-10", state.draftEffectiveDate)
        assertEquals("300", state.draftWelcomeCredits)
        assertEquals("250", state.draftPushFee)
        assertEquals("Persisted note across config changes", state.draftOperatorNote)
    }
}
